# MediaFlow Studio 1.1.0 — Presets & Pro mode

## ✨ What's new

### 🎛️ One-click presets
Drop your files, click once, done. The preset applies to every file in the queue.

| | Preset | Gives you |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 📱 | **TikTok / Shorts** | Vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, loudness −14 LUFS |
| ▶️ | **Clean export** | High-quality H.264 for YouTube, audio 320 kb/s |
| 🎞️ | **Proxy for editing** | ProRes 422 Proxy, max 1080p — smooth timeline in Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut |
| 🎧 | **Extract audio** | WAV 24-bit / 48 kHz |

### 🧠 Smart by default
- **Variable frame rate detected and fixed** — phone, OBS and screen-capture clips no longer drift out of sync in your editor.
- **HDR handled** — iPhone / drone HDR is tone-mapped for 8-bit exports (no more washed-out colors); 10-bit sources stay 10-bit when the codec allows it.
- **Timecode and color metadata kept.**
- **GPU encoding** — NVIDIA (NVENC), Intel (Quick Sync) or AMD (AMF) is detected at startup and used automatically, with a CPU fallback. Up to ×10 faster on 4K.

### 🛠️ Advanced mode
One click on **Advanced** reveals the pro settings, applied on top of any preset:
- Video codec: **ProRes** (Proxy / LT / 422 / HQ), **DNxHR** (LB / SQ / HQ / HQX), H.264, HEVC
- Container (MP4 / MOV / MKV / **MXF**), bit depth, frame rate, resolution
- Audio codec and **tracks** (first, all, or mixed into one)
- GPU on / off
- **Audio Extractor:** pick or mix tracks, mono, **split L / R into two files** (lav mic + camera mic), 24-bit, sample rate

Technical badges (HDR, 10-bit, audio tracks, timecode) appear on each file in Advanced mode only — Simple mode stays clean.

Already on 1.0.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
